sources.title: Mistral 7B
sources.snippet: The best 7B model to date, Apache 2.0 Mistral 7B uses a sliding window attention (SWA) mechanism (Child et al., Beltagy et al.), in which each layer attends to the previous 4,096 hidden states. The main improvement, and reason for which this was initially investigated, is a linear compute cost of O (sliding_window.seq_len).
